hints.title: Running Prefix Sum Modulo
hints.text: Maintain the running sum of the prefix modulo k as you iterate through nums.

hints.title: Check Residue Match
hints.text: At index i, compare the prefix sum modulo k with nums[i] % k.

hints.title: Count Matches
hints.text: Increment the result count whenever the two modular values coincide.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recalculating prefix sums from scratch at every index takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean linear scan with running modular sum.
